method: Start an isolated, supervisor-owned disposable provider process under a distinct UID and accept two synthetic requests.
Observe timeout and disconnection from the client while the provider remains alive.
Restrict the inference identity through the real UnixFenceClient and FenceServer using the separate control UID. Data still denies stop verification.
Kill and reap the named fixture child and observe socket closure. Persist the signed host stop record and verify it under the separate Data UID using the public key and kernel-authenticated fence.
limits: The provider is a disposable synthetic process. This run does not establish LM Studio cancellation or operational stop.
The Data-side verifier used a fixture Ed25519 key. No deployment or serving authority was granted.
The proof establishes the local receipt and fence boundary. Durable database occupancy and full deployed role recovery are separate tests.
